title: Blower Motor Error
shortDescription: The blower fan is not running or is stalled.
fullDescription:
E1 on a Samsung range hood means the control board does not detect the blower motor's tach feedback. The hood will not extract air.

Common causes include a stuck blower wheel, failed capacitor, or a burned-out motor after years of grease buildup.

fixSteps.title: Clean blower wheel
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the filter and blower cover, then degrease the wheel and housing.

fixSteps.title: Replace motor/capacitor if needed
fixSteps.instruction: If cleaning does not help, swap in a new capacitor or motor.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the hood is hard-wired and cannot be easily removed from the wall.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung range hood E1 blower motor fix

faq.q: Can I still cook with E1?
faq.a: Yes but smoke and grease will not be extracted. Open a window.

title: Light Circuit Error
shortDescription: The LED or halogen lighting circuit has faulted.
fullDescription:
E2 indicates the lighting driver or LED module is open or shorted. Cooking lights will not come on.

For LED models the driver module usually fails before the LEDs themselves.

fixSteps.title: Replace bulbs
fixSteps.instruction: For halogen models swap bulbs first.

fixSteps.title: Replace LED driver
fixSteps.instruction: For LED hoods, install a new driver module near the control board.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the hood is installed with chimney covers that complicate access.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung range hood E2 light error fix

faq.a: Usually yes, the lighting circuit is separate.

title: Filter Reminder
shortDescription: The grease filter has exceeded its usage timer.
fullDescription:
E3 is a service reminder, not a hardware fault. Samsung tracks cumulative blower run hours and reminds you to wash the metal grease filter or replace the carbon filter.

Reset the timer after cleaning by holding the Filter button for 3 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Wash filter
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the metal mesh and wash in hot soapy water or dishwasher.

fixSteps.title: Reset timer
fixSteps.instruction: Reinstall filter. Hold Filter button 3 seconds until tone sounds.

videoSearchQuery: Samsung range hood E3 filter reset

faq.q: How often is this supposed to appear?
faq.a: Roughly every 30 hours of blower use on default settings.

title: Smoke / Heat Sensor Error
shortDescription: The auto-sensing infrared or heat sensor has failed.
fullDescription:
E4 is logged when the auto-mode sensor that measures cooking heat below the hood gives bad readings. Auto mode is disabled; manual fan speeds still work.

Grease on the sensor lens is the number one cause.

fixSteps.title: Clean lens
fixSteps.instruction: Use isopropyl alcohol on a cotton swab to clean the small dark lens under the hood.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: If cleaning does not clear E4, install a new sensor module.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the sensor harness is inaccessible.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung range hood E4 heat sensor

faq.q: Can I still use the hood?
faq.a: Yes, only auto mode is affected.

title: Damper Motor Error
shortDescription: The backdraft damper actuator did not open or close properly.
fullDescription:
E5 appears on ducted hoods equipped with a motorized damper. The control board detects that the actuator did not reach its target position.

Cold climate models sometimes see E5 when the damper is iced shut.
symptoms: Outside air leaking in when off

fixSteps.title: Inspect damper
fixSteps.instruction: Climb to the roof/wall cap (if safe) or duct access and verify flapper moves freely.

fixSteps.title: Replace actuator
fixSteps.instruction: Swap the motorized damper assembly if it is seized or burned.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro for any roof-cap work or if ductwork is difficult to access safely.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung range hood E5 damper motor

faq.q: Will the hood still extract air?
faq.a: Partially, but efficiency drops and backdraft is possible.

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: Main PCB and display/touch board have lost communication.
fullDescription:
E6 means the touch panel is not responding to the main PCB. Fan and light outputs may work, but user interaction fails.

A loose ribbon cable between the control pod and the main board is the most common cause.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Switch off breaker for 2 minutes, then restore.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cable
fixSteps.instruction: Drop the hood liner to reach the cable between touch pod and main PCB. Reseat firmly.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if the hood liner cannot be dropped without damaging ductwork or chimney covers.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung range hood E6 communication error

faq.q: Will power cycling fix it permanently?
faq.a: Sometimes, but a loose cable tends to return.

title: Wi-Fi Module Error
shortDescription: The smart connectivity module failed to initialize.
fullDescription:
E7 is reported when the Wi-Fi module does not respond to the main PCB during boot. Core cooking and extraction functions are unaffected; only SmartThings features are offline.

Reset the module by holding the connect button for 5 seconds or power cycle the hood.

fixSteps.title: Reset module
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the Wi-Fi button for 5 seconds and wait for re-pairing mode.

fixSteps.title: Replace module
fixSteps.instruction: If E7 persists, swap the Wi-Fi module plugged into the main PCB.

whenToCallPro: Rarely required. The hood works without Wi-Fi.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung range hood E7 wifi module error

faq.q: Do I need Wi-Fi for the hood to run?
faq.a: No, extraction and lighting work without it.

title: Key Stuck Error
shortDescription: A control key appears stuck active.
fullDescription:
E8 is set when the touch pod detects any key held for longer than 60 seconds. Water between the glass and the sensor or a damaged membrane are typical causes.

Controls remain locked until the condition clears.

fixSteps.title: Clean and dry
fixSteps.instruction: Dry the touch surface thoroughly with a microfiber cloth and leave fan on low for 10 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Replace touch pod
fixSteps.instruction: If E8 persists, install a new touch module.

whenToCallPro: Call a pro if disassembly of the touch pod is outside your comfort.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung range hood E8 key stuck

faq.a: Yes if the glass simply had moisture. Persistent E8 means hardware.
